_what_this_is: A one-use maintainer decision. It states who permitted what, at what cumulative spend, against what cap, and what it does NOT authorize. It deliberately asserts no derived identity: the timestamp, the committed base, the continuation harness digest, both plan hashes and the price are computed by scripts/autoinit/issue_recovery_continuation_authorization.py, which refuses a grant that claims any of them. Consumed by exactly one issuance. The attempt-6 grant and its authorization are SPENT and must not be reused: the tokenizer repair moved both the session commit and the continuation harness digest.
granted_by: Maintainer decision, 2026-08-23. 'GO for Recovery Continuation Attempt 7. I reviewed the tokenizer repair. 30dcee3 is the tested implementation that produced 2183 passed / 12 skipped and continuation harness b824441c; 9ca708a is only the state follow-up pointing baseline_commit at that tested tree, so it does not alter the executable harness. The repair preserves the frozen evaluation protocol correctly. After training, materialize_eval_tokenizer() copies exactly tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and chat_template.jinja from the already-attested CANONICAL_INIT into the trained model directory, with missing-source and conflicting-destination cases failing closed and byte equality reverified. battery() remains unchanged and must continue passing only --model <trained model dir>, with no --tokenizer. Therefore the material tokenizer-source rule remains "the evaluated checkpoint". The existing post-generation RecoveryEvaluationProtocol.require_comparable() remains the authoritative paid-path check that the resulting tokenizer/template/runtime identity actually matches the frozen Stage-3 protocol. Do not change Stage-1 artifact identity or recovery science merely because the evaluation view of the newly trained checkpoint now contains the frozen tokenizer sidecars.' Against last tested implementation 30dcee3, with 9ca708a as the state follow-up. Since attempt 6 one closure landed and was accepted: THE EVALUATION TOKENIZER. Attempt 6 trained a rung-1 probe for 71.9 minutes, resolved its checkpoint through the repaired trained_model_dir(), entered battery() -- past the line that ended attempt 5 -- and then died on apply_chat_template because Trainer.save_checkpoint writes weights and config only, so the checkpoint carried no tokenizer, and uncapped_eval's --tokenizer defaults to the checkpoint's own. Passing --tokenizer was REJECTED as a protocol change: tokenizer_source is material under generation_runtime_comparability@v2 and Stage 0 attests "the evaluated checkpoint", so an external source would make every probe incomparable to the Stage-3 controls that materialized the equivalence interval and feasibility floor. The frozen rule is instead made true by materializing the attested bytes into the evaluated checkpoint. uncapped_eval.py was deliberately untouched because it is part of the generation source digest. Verified on the current tree: full suite 2183 passed / 12 skipped, +7 with the skip count unchanged; frozen-asset verifier passed with no problems; 5 mutations each turning a passing state into a failing one, including a 5-minute end-to-end run proving the stage-1-5 harness catches a removed materialization. The continuation harness digest moved 8b56fc7b -> b824441c.
covers: One (1) launch of the AutoInitializer Phase-A RECOVERY CONTINUATION, attempt 7, on a single NVIDIA L40S at no more than $0.99/h. It imports the verified Attempt-12 Stage-1 result -- the five preserved selected leaves, in the committed selected order, re-identified from the bytes that actually arrive on the pod -- and runs recovery Stages 2 through 5 under the frozen science, the existing watchdog, soft-stop, hard-stop, artifact-gate and provider-confirmed teardown behaviour. Everything ahead of the battery is already demonstrated on paid hardware and is not revisited: the transport (attempts 3-4), Stage 0 and the strict Stage-1 import with control measurement and admission (attempts 4-6), the release and headroom contracts (attempt 5), and the probe checkpoint resolution (attempt 6). Attempts 5 and 6 each trained one rung-1 probe and lost it with its pod; neither is resumable scientific work, so this attempt starts recovery normally from the preserved Stage-1 inputs and retrains. Authorized pricing is DERIVED from continuation_budget(), not written: expected $14.9233, per-launch hard ceiling $16.7456, which is also the hard cap. The beam search is not run, not reconstructed, and is structurally unreachable from this harness.
budget_note: BINDING. The cumulative cap is $234.00 and MUST NOT be increased. Remaining is $16.8237 against a $16.7456 per-launch hard ceiling: the ceiling fits by only $0.0781, and a full-ceiling run brings the project to $233.9219 of $234.00. No cumulative-cap increase, no per-launch-ceiling increase and no live-run budget extension is authorized. Attempt 6's probe took 71.9 minutes against the 61.55 the envelope is priced from; if the host is slower and the existing soft/hard budget machinery stops the session, THAT REFUSAL IS TO BE ACCEPTED and reported, not worked around. THE REMAINING HEADROOM IS NOT AUTHORIZATION.
does_not_authorize: Increasing the cumulative cap, the per-launch ceiling, or any live-run budget extension; overriding, deferring or reinterpreting a soft-stop or hard-stop refusal. Changing Stage-1 artifact identity or recovery science because the evaluation view of a newly trained checkpoint now contains the frozen tokenizer sidecars. Passing --tokenizer to uncapped_eval.py, or otherwise altering the material tokenizer-source rule, the generation source digest, generation comparability v2, the Stage-3 attestation or any frozen threshold or protocol identity. Editing uncapped_eval.py, the trainer, Trainer.save_checkpoint or the frozen recovery recipe. Trained-but-unscored resume or retention machinery. New canaries, new harness layers, Stage-1 work, transport work, or memory recalibration. Rerunning or redesigning Stage 1; a beam search or any reconstruction of the search. Re-ranking or re-selecting the five leaves or changing their committed order. Retraining the permanent controls. Measuring the canonical control more than once or on anything but the frozen Stage-1 suite. Repairing and relaunching on a live pod. Any follow-on or automatically started session. Reusing any spent grant or authorization from attempts 1 through 6. Any other paid session.
fail_closed_instruction: On any new material failure: preserve the full traceback and the stage artifacts, fail closed, collect evidence through the existing supported path, obtain provider-confirmed teardown, and return for review. Do not repair on the live pod and do not relaunch. A refusal by require_released(), require_headroom(), the soft or hard budget stop, or the post-generation require_comparable() check is the INTENDED behaviour of this machinery rather than a failure of the run, and none of them may be weakened or overridden to let the session continue. The five imported Stage-1 leaves are session INPUTS: they are not re-derived, not modified, and their canonical off-pod copies in the dev-box checkpoint store remain the durable record regardless of what happens in Stages 2-5.
on_completion: Report rung-1 results, rung-2 results, whether the conditional seed-sc rung fired, the final selection, retained artifacts, actual spend and provider-confirmed teardown, together with commits and hashes, authorization identity, bundle round-trip and pod lifecycle. Report the observed per-probe training minutes against the 61.55 the envelope is priced from, as evidence for a future pricing review rather than as a basis for changing anything now. Tear the pod down as soon as the run reaches a terminal state rather than waiting for a backstop, and confirm teardown with the provider. Then STOP. Do not self-authorize any subsequent session; after this launch the remaining cumulative headroom cannot fund another one.
